interpretation: The 307-byte residual is dominated by the two swapped RawVec::reserve_for_push monomorphizations; the out-of-window bytes are call-site and relocation fixups that shift because the two bodies exchanged order. The order is not recorded in the stripped binary, and the default f5ce86 recipe selects the candidate2 order. Non-historical ordering inputs (repro/ata/reconstructed-order, repro/ata/synthetic-ordering-exact-build) close the residual to exact raw bytes; the historical input that selected the deployed order remains unknown.
